title: Puzzles - House of Pips Wiki
description: House of Pips puzzles: twenty solo challenges in four sets, how they unlock, and the domino skins and other rewards they give.
html:
Puzzles

Puzzles are hand-made solo challenges. Each one gives you a fixed rack, a fixed table and sometimes a few perks, and asks you to meet a goal such as "Play all 5 bones without scoring" or "Score at least 50 points in a single play". There is no opponent and no boneyard, so every puzzle is pure planning.

How puzzles work #

  • There are 20 puzzles in four sets of five.
  • The first five are open from the start. Every four new solves open the next five.
  • You can try a puzzle as often as you like and replay solved ones.
  • Puzzles don't autosave: if you leave an unfinished puzzle, it starts over next time.
  • Puzzles don't use supplies and don't earn career XP.

Rewards #

  • Finishing a set unlocks that set's domino skin (Arcane Magic, Skull and Crossbones, Galaxy and Jigsaw) and a player portrait.
  • Solving all twenty earns the Puzzle Master achievement and an online placement effect.

Tips #

  • Read the goal twice. "Without scoring" puzzles are about keeping the open ends off multiples of five.
  • Count the open ends before every play, including after your next play.
  • Remember that an open double counts both of its halves. See Domino rules.
